guest: Yes, a recommendation would help; Gabriel loves cheese, while I tend to avoid heavy cream sauces. Nothing too formal or drawn-out.
reply: A relaxed bistro with good cheese and lighter choices sounds a useful direction. You mentioned squeezing in some work—will that shape either of your days, or is it mostly a few emails between outings?
